one_line: A Vatsa-era artisan-merchant from Kausambi, helping build its mighty ramparts and thrive on Yamuna trade routes.

appearance.age_look: late 20s, lean but strong, wiry build from manual labour and travel
appearance.face: oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, thick brows, a small healed scar on the left cheek, and sharp, focused eyes; default expression is determined yet approachable, often with a slight half-smile of pride.
appearance.hair: black hair tied back in a short, neat topknot at the crown with the rest cropped to nape length; a plain off-white cloth headband wraps around the forehead, knotted at the back with short tails.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length cotton anga (tunic) in muted indigo blue with a simple round neck and short, wide sleeves, tied at the waist with a narrow brown woven belt; over this is a light, unbleached off-white cotton uttariya (shawl) draped from the left shoulder across the chest and back, kept snug for work; his lower garment is a straight, ankle-length dhoti in pale ochre, pleated in front and wrapped securely for movement, with a subtle woven border in darker brown; he has simple leather sandals, bronze bangles on his right wrist, a small copper amulet on a dark cord at his neck, and a practical cloth pouch hanging from his belt.
appearance.signature: A sturdy wooden measuring rod marked with carved notches, about the length of his forearm, often carried in his right hand or tucked under his arm, symbolising both his role in planning ramparts and his care for fair trade.

ref_desc: A lean, medium-brown man in an indigo tunic, pale ochre ankle-length dhoti, off-white shawl, leather sandals, headbanded topknot, simple bangles and amulet, always carrying a wooden measuring rod, in a palette of indigo, off-white, pale ochre, brown and bronze.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body model sheet of a late-20s, lean, medium-brown Vatsa-era artisan-merchant from Kausambi in anime style: an oval-faced man with a small scar on his left cheek, sharp focused eyes and a calm, determined half-smile; his black hair is tied in a neat topknot with a plain off-white cloth headband around his forehead. He wears a muted indigo blue knee-length cotton tunic with short wide sleeves, belted at the waist with a narrow brown woven belt, and an off-white cotton shawl draped from his left shoulder across chest and back in a practical wrap. His lower garment is a straight, ankle-length pale ochre dhoti, tightly wrapped and pleated in front with a subtle darker brown woven border, and he stands in simple brown leather sandals. Add small but clear details: bronze bangles on his right wrist, a tiny copper amulet on a dark cord around his neck, and a modest cloth pouch hanging from his belt. His one constant prop is a sturdy wooden measuring rod with carved notches, shown prominently in his hand or tucked under his arm. Use a limited palette of indigo blue, off-white, pale ochre, brown and bronze, and present him in neutral, front and slight-angle poses to emphasize the consistent face, topknot and headband, garments, and measuring rod.
